scope: Four Core narration APIs and their production/test callers
status: Source refactor complete; scoped Aislop verification passed. Final solution tests and coverage are recorded separately by the C# verification task.

apis.change: Surrounding prose and scene emotion/intensity travel together in EmotionDirectionContext; writer override, language rules and magnitude remain explicit.
NarrationLanguageContext groups dialogue/direction/utterance rules; SceneNarrationSettings groups the writer's assignments and scene emotion/intensity.
NarrationRenderContext carries cast and engine resources; reading rate and per-segment placement remain explicit.
The same NarrationRenderContext is reused across chapter windows; settings, progress and cancellation remain explicit.

behaviorReview: Null scene settings still leave all writer assignments unset; absent utterance rules still use UtteranceLanguage.None.
Explicit blank direction overrides remain neutral and do not fall through to scene emotion. Following speech tags still precede earlier tags and scene emotion.
Voice and clip dictionaries are retained by reference. Voice reference texts are still filtered to available voices before constructing the engine request.
Reading-rate defaults, chapter/scene placement, cache fingerprints, progress and cancellation forwarding are unchanged.

verification.scopedCommand: aislop scan --include <17 exact narration source and test paths> --json
verification.testChange: Build_CarriesTheWordsAndTheVoiceEachIsReadIn now additionally verifies voice dictionary identity with Assert.Same; all existing direction, script, render and job tests were migrated to the typed APIs.
verification.finalTestsAndCoverage: See the final C# verification report; this scoped report does not claim coverage.
